# scm_dlp_data_profile (Data Source)

> **Beta / Experimental:** Enterprise DLP support (`scm_dlp_*`) in `terraform-provider-scm` is currently in **Beta / Experimental** and subject to schema or behavior changes.

[Beta / Experimental] DLP Data Profile data source (`/v2/api/data-profiles/{id}`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a DLP data profile by its ID.
data "scm_dlp_data_profile" "example" {
  id = "REPLACE_WITH_ID"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the data profile.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the data profile.
- `detection_rules` (Attributes List) List of detection rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--detection_rules))
- `is_granular_data_profile` (Boolean) Whether this is a granular data profile.
- `name` (String) The name of the data profile.
- `profile_status` (String) Profile status (`active`, `inactive`).
- `profile_type` (String) Profile type (`advanced`, `basic`).
- `tfid` (String) The Terraform ID.
- `version` (Number) The version number of the profile.
